ACCESS TIME OR AVERAGE ACCESS TIME:

In storage devices, average access time is the time required for a
read / write head to move to a spot on the storage medium. For
storage devices, access time is measured in milliseconds (ms), or
thousandths of a second. In memory, access time is measured in
nanoseconds (ns). Diskette drives offer an average access time of
100ms. Hard drives are faster, usually between 6-12ms.
